descriptionlist.description: This is a full reimplementation of the PC version of Toy Story.
It contains a reworked engine, so some of the jank from the PC version has been fully cut out.
To play this game, you need your own data files. Place your installed "TOYSTORY" folder inside "/var/mobile/Media/ToyStory", and your ripped disc images "ts.bin" and "ts.cue" into that same folder.
Use the D-Pad to move, and the two action buttons to play through the game.
